HeroContent.title: Hero Content
HeroContent.description: Defines the text and image structure for the landing / hero section

tag.description: The system section indicator tag, e.g. 'SYS.INIT // STUDENT PROFILE'

heroTitle.description: Display-level header title text with line-breaks

highlight.description: Short summary or key phrase of the description

heroDescription.description: A long description paragraph detailing interests

heroImageBase64.description: High-compressed Base64 string of the main hero graphic

title.description: The title of the experience or event, e.g. '2025 Robot Challenge: SUMO'

description.description: Description of the role and team name

SkillItem.title: Skill Item
SkillItem.description: Defines a conceptual chip representing a robot programming/building skill

name.description: Name of the skill, e.g. 'C CODING'

AwardItem.title: Award Item
AwardItem.description: Defines an award or certificate item

title.description: Award name, e.g. '2026 RoboCup Korea Open : Super team 1st Place'

PortfolioItem.title: Portfolio Item
PortfolioItem.description: Defines a single portfolio card displaying a developed robotic project using Base64 imagery

description.description: Short explanation of the robotic task

imageBase64.description: High-compressed Base64 string of the project preview cover

/siteContent/main.description: Document representing hero texts and base64 background details

/awards/{awardId}.description: Collection of achievements and tournament rankings

/portfolioItems/{itemId}.description: Collection of actual showcased robot works with details and Base64 images
